skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key concepts related to cartography, digital maps, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS), components of maps, mathematical foundations of cartography, functional components of GIS, and applications of GIS.
Grasp methods for representing maps, using maps, and GIS data.
Explain and apply cartographic knowledge to analyze, evaluate, and synthesize information and data presented on maps to serve professional tasks.
Possess skills in organizing and managing GIS databases, methods for analyzing and processing digital map data and geographic information on computers.
Apply comprehensive cartographic knowledge to exploit and utilize map reference information to serve natural resource management tasks.
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work.
Proactively choose issues, analyze, and present problems.
